notes: Demo Qi4D Max 10.5 with 60g stiff shaft. First session after GolfTec setup changes.

stretches.label: Best stretch
stretches.cue: Push draw from GolfTec setup changes

findings.title: The baseline
findings.body: The new head with the setup changes from the lesson produced a push draw on the best stretch, but the screen did not capture strike location, attack angle or dynamic loft, so this session anchors the ball-flight comparison only.

notes: Hit after 9 sim holes. Fatigued late.

findings.title: Low takeaway fixed strike and face
findings.body: Shots 23-27 came after adding a deliberate low takeaway. Vertical strike moved to about 1 mm from center and face-to-path tightened to about 1°. The session faded after that, likely from fatigue after 9 sim holes.

notes: Worked on dropping the trail shoulder for a push draw.

findings.title: Shoulder drop moved the path way out
findings.body: Dropping the trail shoulder sent the path well in-to-out: about +8° on shots 1-14. The face followed the path almost exactly, so the ball started right and never curved back. Those drives averaged 44 yards right. That's a push with no draw.

findings.title: Dialed back, it was the longest stretch yet
findings.body: Shots 33-40 had a path around +2° and the face slightly closed to it. They averaged 149 mph ball speed, 1.47 smash, 241 carry and 259 total, with an average miss of 16 yards.

notes: Shots 1-13 before a 7 iron break with tee height changing; 14-21 after, higher tee locked in. Swing thought 85-90% effort.

findings.title: A higher tee fixed the low strike
findings.body: Shots 1-13 came before a 7 iron break, with tee height still changing. After the break the higher tee was locked in and attack angle rose from about +3° to +5.5°. Strike moved from 15 mm low to 6 mm low, spin dropped from about 3,400 to 2,600 rpm, and carry jumped from 200 to 229 yards.

findings.title: The push draw showed up
findings.body: On shots 14-21 the path stayed around +3° with the face closed to it by about 1°. Six of the eight had draw spin, and they averaged 1 yard left of the target line.

findings.title: 85-90% effort, same speed
findings.body: Club speed still averaged 100 mph, the same as full-effort sessions, and after the break it averaged 102. Shot 14, the first drive after 32 seven irons, went 238 carry and 254 total, struck 3 mm from center.

notes: Qi4D with a shorter shaft. New move: trail shoulder dip/bow to keep hands low and in the slot so the face can close. Compact swing. Shot 6 is a sim misread (excluded).

stretches.label: New move settling
stretches.cue: Trail shoulder dip, hands low, face closing

findings.title: The new move closed the face
findings.body: With the trail-shoulder dip, face-to-path went from about +3° on shots 1-9 to about −1.5° on shots 10-17. That is the change the move was meant to make: the face stopped hanging open to the path.

findings.title: Strike moved across the face
findings.body: Six drives were struck 32-51 mm from center horizontally, all on the same side, and averaged 1.30 smash and 174 carry. The ten strikes within 25 mm averaged 1.43 smash and 207 carry. Shorter shaft plus a new move changed where the ball met the face.

findings.title: Path is now reliably in-to-out
findings.body: Every clean drive had a path between +1.4° and +6.3°, averaging about +3.7°. Attack angle averaged +6°, the highest of any session. Shot 6 is a sim misread and is left out of the club averages.

notes: Evening session after 18 sim holes, applying the lesson move (trail shoulder dip, hands low). Shots 6 and 20 have sim club-data misreads (club fields null). Spin very low: dynamic loft about 11 deg, strikes high on the face.

findings.title: Tightest dispersion of any session
findings.body: 32 drives averaged 19 yards from the line, centered 5 yards right, with half of them carrying draw spin. Face-to-path averaged 2.2° and the path was a gentle +1.8°. The move from the lesson held up without the coach watching.

findings.title: Spin collapsed
findings.body: Backspin averaged 1,970 rpm, down from 2,600-3,400 in every other session. Dynamic loft dropped to about 11° (from 17-18°) and strikes averaged 16 mm above center. Nine drives under 1,400 rpm carried only 169 yards despite 146 mph ball speed. Drives with 1,400-2,600 rpm carried 216 and ran out to 250.

findings.title: Fatigue after 18 holes
findings.body: Shots 1-13 averaged 222 carry and 250 total. Shots 20-32 averaged 179 carry. Shots 10-14 were the best five in a row: 229 carry, 257 total, 1.42 smash, face within 1.3° of the path. Shots 6 and 20 are sim club-data misreads and are left out of the club averages.

notes: Cold warm-up before 9 sim holes. Low strikes, face open, high spin.

findings.title: The cold warm-up looked like the old swing
findings.body: The first 24 drives struck 12 mm low, spun 3,500 rpm and missed 22 yards right on average, with the face 1.5° open to the path. Only 21% would have stayed in a 30-yard fairway. That is the pattern to expect from a first tee shot without a routine.

notes: After 9 sim holes. Centered strike, spin 2,500 rpm, longest full session.

findings.title: Spin and strike landed in the window
findings.body: 31 drives averaged 2,530 rpm, vertical strike within 1 mm of center, 1.43 smash, and the group centered on the target line (1 yard right on average). Carry averaged 226 and total 246. Shots 14-31 averaged 232 carry.

findings.title: The face decides where it goes
findings.body: Across 218 drives with club data, offline distance tracks face angle closely (correlation 0.81) and path barely at all (0.23). Path stays within about 1° from swing to swing; the face varies 2-3.5°. Each degree of face-to-path moves the finish about 8 yards.

findings.title: Spin comes from delivered loft
findings.body: Backspin follows spin loft (dynamic loft minus attack angle) at about 190 rpm per degree. Strike height matters less, about 36 rpm per mm. The R9 sessions delivered 18-20° of dynamic loft; the Qi4D short-shaft sessions 10-16°, which is where the low-spin drives came from.
